name: Map Posters
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Poster-style maps of any place on earth, powered by OpenStreetMap: search a location, pick a poster type and a design theme, pan and zoom the live vector preview, add geocoded pins with routes and distances. Poster types go beyond the street map: the map seen through big LETTERS (a name, a word, a date), SEVERAL PLACES side by side with their names and dates, a FIGURE-GROUND plan with the buildings in ink, the WATER NETWORK alone, a STREET COMPASS that colors every street by its direction with a direction rose, an OLD MAP on aged paper with engraved lines, compass rose and frame, and a DIRECTIONS SKETCH with cased main roads and distance rings. North arrow, scale bar, coordinate ticks and numbered pins with a legend work on every type - and style the streets themselves: FOIL roads in gold, copper, chrome or color gradients (main arteries take the hot gloss band, alleys sink into the rim, or run one gradient across the whole poster) plus a neon GLOW slider that turns the city into lights. Choose a shape mask and insert the map with a classic title and coordinates text block - all as editable layers. Reopen any map via Edit Map Posters.
